name: trans-genderian-orchestra
description: Agent orchestration plugin for OpenCode with specialist delegation and review loops

scripts.clean:dist: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opencode-ai/sdk/* --external jsdom --external zod
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opentui/solid --external zod
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opencode-ai/sdk/* --external jsdom --external zod
scripts.build: bun run clean:dist && bun run build:plugin && bun run build:tui && bun run build:cli && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
